concepts.title: Told in order
concepts.logline: One day of a brass band learning one song, each section later than the last.
concepts.why: It shows a brass band learning one song changing instead of describing it.
concepts.world: The ordinary places of a brass band learning one song, in plain daylight.
concepts.signature_moment: The last image of a brass band learning one song changes how the first one reads.
concepts.risk: It only works if the small changes are visible at a glance.
